## 安全召回

- **[I tested this lithium-ion battery charging cabinet as the safest place to charge your e-bike batteries](https://electrek.co/2026/08/25/i-tested-this-lithium-ion-battery-charging-cabinet-as-the-safest-place-to-charge-your-e-bike-batteries/)**｜Electrek e-bikes｜Tue, 25 Aug 2026 14:36:27 +0000  
  One of the most common questions I get from readers isn’t just about speed or range anymore. Increasingly, I’m hearing more questions about battery safety. People see the occasional viral video of an e-bike battery fire and wonder if they should be worried about charging their battery in the garage, apartment, or workshop. The reality is that quality lithium-ion batteries from reputable manufacturers are remarkably safe , but when failures do occur, they can be dramatic enough that many riders want an extra layer of protection. That’s where products like Yolin’s lithium-ion battery charging cabinet come in. I recently spent some time testing the cabinet, and while I admittedly wasn’t sure what to expect going in, I came away more impressed than I anticipated.
